items.decryption: Use this to sequence the major life events: Birth (Lotus/Bull), Renunciation (Horse), Enlightenment (Bodhi Tree), First Sermon (Wheel), Death (Stupa).

traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Confusing the location of birth (Lumbini) with the place of the first sermon (Sarnath).
Assuming Buddha lived in the Mauryan period; he was a contemporary of Bimbisara and Ajatashatru.
Equating 'Nirvana' with physical death; Nirvana is enlightenment, Mahaparinirvana is death.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Lumbini: Birthplace
  • Bodh Gaya: Enlightenment
  • Sarnath: First Sermon
  • Kushinagar: Death

Personalities

  • Suddhodana: Father
  • Mahamaya: Mother
  • Yashodhara: Wife
  • Rahul: Son
  • Channa: Charioteer

Life Events Mindmap

  • Early Life: Born in Lumbini, raised in Kapilavastu.
  • The Four Sights: Old man, Diseased man, Dead man, Ascetic.
  • Renunciation: Left the palace at 29 (Mahabhinishkramana).
  • Teachers: Alara Kalama and Udraka Ramaputra.
  • Enlightenment: Attained at Bodh Gaya under the Bodhi tree.
  • Dharmachakrapravartana: Turning of the Wheel of Law at Sarnath.
